_help: Host this file in your GitHub repo (main branch). One entry per supporter. 'total' is dollars tipped and decides the badge tier (10 white, 25 bronze, 50 silver, 100+ gold). 'owned' lists what they bought, 'loadout' what they have equipped, 'gifts' how many gifts they have given (earns the Gifter title). Use tools/grant.js to edit it. Example entry: {"login": "name", "total": 30, "owned": {"effects": ["glow"]}, "loadout": {"effect": "glow"}}.
